title: Criatura IA Protocol v3
supersedes: protocol-v2.json (Task 002 etapa 1). v3 = Task 002 etapa 2, T2.3 (docs/tasks/008-proposta-protocolo-v3.md). Brains trained on v2 are incompatible: retrain from zero.

vision.layout: 72 rays (3 pitch rows x 24 yaw) x 14: distance/range, one-hot [none, soil, sand, stone, snow, water, wood, leaves, plant, thorny, meat, creature, salt_water]

creatureSectors.layout: 4 yaw sectors of the eye row x (r, g, b, relative size clamp 0..4, carnivore, kin (parent, young or sibling), female, mature, juvenile), averaged over hits

olfaction.layout: plants, fresh water, salt water, creatures, threat; each (body, nose-body, right-body). body = log1p(k*s)/log1p(k), k = 10000; differences = ln(1+k*s_nose) - ln(1+k*s_body), clamped -1..1

proprioception.layout: local velocity xyz /10, turn, on floor, head pitch, sleeping, in water, climbing, blocked

interoception.layout: energy, water, body temperature, head, torso, legs, fatigue, pain, libido, age fraction, mature, fear (same 12 as v2, read by the reward; age fraction = age / longevity gene), gestation, offspring nearby in need

time.layout: sin, cos of time of day; photoperiod 0..1 (long summer days = 1); photoperiod trend (sin of year, > 0 lengthening); light now 0..1; climate temperature offset / 20 C

genes.layout: expressed body/life genes of GeneCatalog.Basic (every locus not prefixed m_), catalog order, each (value - min) / (max - min)

motivations.layout: individual reward weights = motivation genes, raw values: energy, water, temperature, integrity, fatigue, libido, pain, fear, care

eventPayloads.ATE: u32 id, u8 resource (0 plant, 1 meat), f32 amount
eventPayloads.DAMAGED: u32 id, u8 zone, u32 source
eventPayloads.BIRTH: u32 child, u32 mother, u32 father
eventPayloads.FED: u32 feeder, u32 child, f32 energy

flow.lockstep: The simulator sends STEP(tick) and pauses; Python answers with zero or more SPAWN frames followed by exactly one ACT(tick).
flow.spawn: SPAWN ids must be new (never reused). The spawned creature is created before physics resumes and first appears in STEP(tick+1). It is not part of ACT(tick).
flow.population: Etapa 2: the simulator owns the population (births, archive rescue below a minimum, cap). Ids >= 2^30 are created by the simulator; brain SPAWN ids stay below 2^30.
flow.interoceptionExtra: gestation = progress 0..1 of the current pregnancy; offspring in need = own young within 6 m with energy < 0.5

STEP: event_count * (u8 type + u16 length + bytes payload)
